intents.availability: Shared definition has no is_shown gate; not sufficient to prove pilgrimage host availability. Current potential-intent set not observed.
intents.effect: No unconditional stress subtraction on selection. pilgrimage.6001 weight factor 2, with BP1/friend/location/progress gates; first option adds worldly score and 30-day delay before follow-up. Downstream 6003/6004 can give reveler trait/XP; stress response is personality-dependent and may increase. It does not add arbitrary personality traits when selecting intent.

Enables intent.1030/1040/1050/1060/1100 and reflection pulse actions; effects depend on choices (piety, pilgrim or mystic XP, stress, delay). auto_complete is not a fixed reward. 1030.a: +10 type-score if pious/Hajj, +10-day travel delay, no pilgrim→50piety; existing pilgrim<100→10XP; capped pilgrim→100piety; existing mystic extraXP; stress differs by personality. 1100.a adds10-year monthly-piety+10% modifier and eligible pilgrim5XP;1100.b gives worldly-score and medium stress loss.

No fixed start charge or guaranteed net profit. Shared sea1110.a can add pious/Hajj score10, entourage opinion+15 and eligible pilgrim5XP. 1005.a/1006.a spend medium_gold_value and give100piety plus10-year local modifier; their stress response can be positive or negative by personality.

court_weights.core: bodyguard/akolouthos +1000, good knight +5, qualifying relationship/faith +100 or10, court chaplain/devoted +300; bannable diarch -5000

court_weights.everyone: same-faith non-designated-diarch councillor +100, learning education +25, adult +1; diarch penalty

start_fill.local_candidates: available, not own court, same Faith, not cynical or secret non-believer; not already entourage and not bannable serving diarch

entourage.important: No/few/all are descriptive shorthand for pomp choices, not a separate verified three-switch entourage menu. Humble excludes a pomp-specific court-selection block, but does not prove zero actual companions.

cost_model.scope: Scripted planned charges are not total trip expenditure; dynamic event payments, court salary and later choices remain separate.

base.formula: standard_activity_base_cost × era, followed by ordered conditional adjustments and floor minor_gold_value
base.standard_base: 30×max(primary_title.tier−1,1); tribal ×0.5; king/emperor tier>duchy +50; AI difficulty reductions only for AI.

base_adjustments_order: subtract medium_gold_value separately for hunt badge urge, ghost promised, hajj promised, pilgrimage promised modifiers
estate parameter subtract 0.2×era-scaled pilgrimage_base_cost (after prior multipliers)
e_minister_of_revenue title ×0.85 in actual activity cost wrapper

distance_charge.basis: squared capital-to-selected-province map distance, not route kilometres
distance_charge.formula: medium_gold_value×band×era; then matching imaginary-friend ×0.5, landed-adventurer-government+clerical_justifications ×0.5, funded modifier×0.5 as actual branch predicates

currencies.activity: Gold unless government_is_theocracy AND has_treasury, then treasury.
currencies.travel_options: Paid general travel options use has_treasury routing; nomadic branches can additionally charge herd and halve gold. This differs from the activity routing.

cost_model.prediction: ui_predicted_cost averages Holy Site distance values and is not the selected-route final quote.
cost_model.dynamic_gold: medium_gold_value is monthly income×medium multiplier, special treasury-vassal quartering, min/max and upward rounding to 5; never a universal fixed coin price.

call_chain: activity on_start sets squared-distance reward class
travel/events/pulses alter actual resources and/or type progression
arrival can grant pilgrim trait and length compensation; Hajj uses ritual chain
phase on_end resolves score flags, triggers7000, calls completed log effect
completed effect applies main piety and eligible type rewards
7000 regular option displays reward via show_as_tooltip; does not issue main reward a second time
home return is a later distinct travel state/event
rewards.main_piety_order: ((distance_base×eligible_dynasty×fidelity_reward_factor×pious_flag_multiplier)+experienced-piety-flag50+pomp_additive)×inner-journey-humble1.5×matching-non-eminent-site0.5×confederation1.1; only qualifying conditions apply. Other separate tenet/event piety is not inside this expression.

worldly.culture_head_with_tracked_cultures: acceptance +1/+3/+5/+7 to every tracked culture, according to score band; both >5 and other script branches iterate the whole list, so do not infer a five-culture cap from comment.
worldly.otherwise: five-year character modifier: culture opinion of/received and different Faith opinion, stress_gain_mult; low culture outgoing10/incoming5, not symmetric10.

rewards.arrival_trait: Normal arrival gives pilgrim when absent; existing-host nested else_if block at S05:236-270 is structurally unusual, so do not assert a guaranteed flat repeated-arrival20XP from its comment. Source-positive explicit post-completion5/10/20/40 and event-specific XP are separate.
rewards.hajj_trait: Completion gives hajjaj if absent; existing hajjaj gives major learning-lifestyle XP if learning lifestyle, otherwise should_get_trait_piety. Hajj pious score does not itself mean hajjaj XP; pious XP helper requires pilgrim trait and XP<100.
rewards.extra_tenet_effects: Armed Pilgrimages, Mendicant Preachers, Pentarchy, Struggle/Submission, Ancestor Worship10-year modifiers; Esotericism weighted mystic trait/XP; personal Pentarchy circuit; spiritual fulfillment +5 or mandatory rite+10; Sacred Mountains matching terrain +100 piety separately; poverty-host guarded separate payout.

destination.general: Faith holy_sites province filter, eligible adult and playable/physically able actor, capital present, rite not forbidden, cooldowns, active activity invalidation rules.
destination.filters: Recent same Holy Site memory five years; Hajj Makka-only; non-adventurer cannot own capital; restricted serving diarch only liege realm; China emperor home-realm restriction is AI-only.
destination.cooldown_caveat: Hajj option1-year check does not override coexisting general5-year destination checks.
destination.effects: Destination determines two independent squared-distance scales (8 cost bands vs4 reward bands), specific arrival first-valid religious pool, Hajj ritual branch, culture path exposure, non-eminent-site main piety×0.5 and optional mountain-tenet bonus.

travel_settings.route: Native route editor supports waypoint add/remove and IsRouteValid/ApplyChanges. Pilgrimage max_route_deviation_mult=3.0 vs general default2.0; neither is a fixed cost or time multiplier.
travel_settings.caravan_master: 旅队主管 chosen through court-position appointment, not pilgrimage type/intent. Native travel_leader_speed/safety contribute to planner; exact engine evaluation not reimplemented. Court salary is separate and conditional.
travel_settings.speed_safety: Travel speed and safety adders/percent modifiers and terrain danger are separate dimensions. Terrain-specific reductions are not global safety, and safety never guarantees event immunity.
travel_settings.route_consequences: Movement calls travel_event_tombola and danger events; pilgrimage pool only outbound, not on capital-return leg. Worldly tracking and traveler/lifestyle XP also depend on movement.

gaps.detail: Shared 娱乐 definition and pilgrimage consumer found; native full four-choice set not stored in searched old reads. User-reportedUI4 preserved. No claim that it is unavailable.
Source predicates are complete for listed catalog, not a live menu/CanPick result for any current actor.
GUI calls and data predicates located; final computed quote/speed/route validation are native. No invented formula or fixed final time multiplier.
S05:236-270 host repeat-arrival XP branch has nested else_if shape; no guarantee of flat XP inferred without runtime.

search_coverage.definition_scan: All top-level definitions in common/travel/travel_options/*.txt, all pilgrimage activity options, all intents files, all matching callers/readers of these keys in common/events/gui.
search_coverage.historical_intent_scan: Existing R0022/R0031 JSON/JSONL only; no replay, game launch, media decode or new capture.
search_coverage.omissions: No selected actor live availability, no new runtime option list, no engine decompilation or replacement formula. Enumerating all travel catalog definitions is not claiming all29 are simultaneously shown to one actor.
